source_text: This perspective emphasizes absolute risk reductions, noting that neonatal UTI incidence is approximately 1% in uncircumcised males versus 0.1-0.2% in circumcised ones, and penile cancer rates remain exceedingly low (less than 1 in 100,000 annually in developed nations), arguing these do not justify universal application.
